forbidden_dependencies: SSE/WebSocket -> raw SDK stream as canonical product state

rest.role: authoritative commands, queries, uploads, idempotency, resource retrieval and auditable decisions

sse.role: authoritative persisted one-way Run Event projection with Last-Event-ID/cursor replay

websocket.role: optional low-latency bidirectional client channel using the same application commands and persisted event identities
rules: authentication at connection and authorization for every message
accepted state changes pass through application commands
product events are persisted before broadcast
recovery uses REST/SSE cursor; WebSocket is not the durable ledger
raw model/SDK deltas are explicitly ephemeral and never replace Product Events
approval decisions and destructive lifecycle operations remain REST-first auditable commands
